title: Job Start → First Day on Site
short_answer: Sales owned the bid until Ops accepted the packet. The handoff PDF is the job. This is how you open a site without guessing.
summary: Sales owned the bid until Ops accepted the packet. The handoff PDF is the job. This is how you open a site without guessing.
plain_words: If the packet is incomplete, send it back — do not "figure it out on site." Lock box, board count, exclusions, open questions, builder/supervisor, and city/state/ZIP in the name exist so you are not inventing a job in a stairwell with one bar of signal.
when_to_use: First mobilization day after Ops accepts the Job Start packet
Before crew touches layout, hang, or conditions work
When lock box, open questions, or exclusions are still unclear
prerequisites: Job Start packet accepted by Ops (not still with Sales)
Handoff PDF available in the job's Drive Handoff folder

steps.body: Confirm Ops accepted the Job Start packet. Until then, the job is not yours to mobilize.
Open the Handoff PDF in Drive (job Handoff folder). Read exclusions and open questions out loud with the crew lead.
Access: lock box / keys / who to call if locked out. Photo the box location for the crew chat.
Conditions: scaffold/lift, heater/cans, power, water, dumpster — match the packet, do not assume.
Layout truth: job name should carry street + city + ST + ZIP | builder. If geography is missing, ask the office — we work in three states with repeat road names.
Do not invent scope, SF, or 1-side/2-side language in client-facing talk — those scrub rules exist because scope reviews are internal.

warnings.title: Incomplete packet
warnings.body: Missing lock box, missing exclusions, unanswered open questions that block framing/hang — send back to Sales/Ops. Starting anyway turns every ambiguity into a change-order fight or free work.

quality_checks.prompt: Exclusions and open questions read aloud with the lead
Lock box / access documented (photo in crew chat)

common_mistakes.title: Figuring it out on site
common_mistakes.wrong: Mobilize with a blank lock box field or unanswered open questions
common_mistakes.right: Send the packet back to Sales/Ops until complete
common_mistakes.why: Ambiguity becomes free work or a CO fight

common_mistakes.title: Client-facing scope slip
common_mistakes.wrong: Quote square footage or 1-side/2-side from internal scope review
common_mistakes.right: Use scrubbed client language only; internal docs stay internal
